inherited_from_h5.axes: EXISTS (live dir()/introspection on 22.0.368)  x  DOCUMENTED STATUS (H22 reference)

cells.exists + documented DEPRECATED: DECAY_CLOCK - works today, breaks on the release that removes it
cells.exists + undocumented: PRIVATE_API - can vanish in a point release with no deprecation notice, because it was never promised
cells.exists + real member on a DIFFERENT owne: MISATTRIBUTED - absence IS proof at the stated owner, but the leaf name is a real member elsewhere in the table. 'Wrong owner' is a different and far more actionable defect than 'does not exist'. H22 split hou.NetworkItem > NetworkMovableItem > Node > OpNode, which strands many hou.Node.* references.

inherited_from_h5.UNVERIFIABLE: either axis undecidable on the available evidence. R59: 'not on the page I read' and 'not documented' are DIFFERENT CLAIMS. Never guess a quadrant.
inherited_from_h5.OUT_OF_MATRIX: parameter-name literals - not symbols in the HOM or node reference, so the matrix does not apply. Counted separately so they neither inflate UNVERIFIABLE nor vanish.

h7_additions.doc_silent_deprecation: runtime deprecationInfo() says deprecated, the AUTHORED help shipped with this build does not. R72 rule 4: the most dangerous cell, because every human-facing surface says the symbol is fine.
h7_additions.DECAY_CLOCK:doc_only: authored help deprecates it, runtime did not flag it. The other half of R72 rule 3's union; this is what corrects the floor upward.
h7_additions.OK:documented_current_exists_unprobed: documented and current in the shipped reference; EXISTS rests on H5's documented_basis rule, not a probe. Recorded so the two are never confused.
h7_additions.OK:exists_undocumented_shipped_module: defined in the build's own shipped source; outside the published HOM surface, so 'documented' does not apply.
h7_additions.OUT_OF_REFERENCE_SCOPE:third_party: pxr/OpenUSD. EXISTS is decided; the H22 reference is not the doc authority. PRIVATE_API would be a false alarm and UNVERIFIABLE would imply a local oracle exists and was not read. Neither is true.
h7_additions.OUT_OF_MATRIX:no_houdini_referent: absent from every local reference AND from the dir() table's leaf set. Census over-collection, not a compat question.
h7_additions.MISATTRIBUTED:doc_spelling: the shipped reference documents the symbol under a different owner spelling (capitalisation). Wrong owner is actionable; undecidable is not.
h7_additions.UNVERIFIABLE:*: every residual now carries a NAMED reason. See residual.

decay_clock.r72_rule_3: deprecation is the UNION of runtime deprecationInfo() and authored help; disagreement between them is itself a finding and gets its own cell.
decay_clock.verdict: H5's floor of 19 is CORRECTED UPWARD to 41 with per-symbol anchors below. It remains a floor, not a total: the residual buckets contain symbols whose deprecation status no local source can decide.

doc_silent_deprecation.confirmed_against: the AUTHORITATIVE build-shipped node reference, not the browsing cache. R72 established this on the cache; H7 re-tested it on nodes.zip and it HOLDS: lop/karmarenderproperties.txt (56,325 chars, #since 18.0) and lop/karma.txt (2,556 chars) carry no deprecation marker of any of the five kinds this leg detects, while the runtime flags both.
doc_silent_deprecation.why_it_is_the_dangerous_cell: an artist reading the shipped help has no way to learn these node types are decaying, and SYNAPSE emits them 123 and 31 times.

doc_only_deprecation.binding_caveat: a bare leaf is bound by INVARIANCE over the documented owners - every documented owner of that leaf is deprecated, so the verdict does not depend on which one the census meant. It does NOT prove the call site is a HOM object at all. The 12 conditional rows are actionable leads, not verdicts.

deprecation_marker_vocabulary.effect_of_tightening: the first, page-wide detector reported 85 doc-side deprecations. After region-scoping, the variable-notice guard, the self-named-member guard and context invariance: 39. Every one of the removed rows was inspected line-by-line.

residual.honest_statement: R72 framed H5's 1267 as partly a REACHABILITY artifact. Fixing reachability accounts for less of it than expected. The bucket decomposes into four causes, only one of which is reachability.

decomposition.reachability_or_oracle_scope: resolved here - 596 rows. The oracles existed locally and were not indexed: tops.zip for pdg, the shipped python source for hdefereval, and nodes.zip applied to the node_type rows H5's live probe never reached.
decomposition.census_over_collection: 8 rows are not Houdini symbols at all - bare SYNAPSE-local method names, malformed tokens ('...', '_doc', '_provenance', 'symbols_PHANTOM_do_not_use') and one FILENAME ('hdefereval.py'). H5's UNVERIFIABLE was inflated by census scope, not only by doc access.
decomposition.instrument_limit_no_source_can_fix: 6 rows: hou.session is a user-data namespace assigned at runtime. Permanently undecidable, and that is the correct answer, not a gap.
decomposition.genuinely_unknown: 671 rows. The real unknown after reachability is fixed.

largest_residual_bucket.what_it_is: the census recorded a BARE method name with no dotted owner. The leaf exists somewhere on the build but cannot be bound to the owner at the call site, and existing-somewhere is not existing-here.
largest_residual_bucket.reading: the largest slice is pxr-shaped - `Get` (249 occurrences, 135 table owners), `Set` (328), `GetPrimAtPath` (258), `GetAttribute` (197) are OpenUSD names the census recorded as hom_method. They are not HOM-reference questions at all. This is a CENSUS KIND defect, and fixing it is the single highest-yield change available to the next compat pass.

what_would_close_more: a live node-type existence probe would decide the EXISTS axis on the 104 node_absent_from_reference_and_unprobed rows and confirm the 172 documented-but-unprobed rows. H7 ran no live probe: the brief scoped this leg to local references and H5's existing runtime verdicts, and a hython run contends for the licence with the live session.
a census that emits DOTTED owners for method calls would collapse the 528-row leaf_unbound_owner bucket. No doc source can fix an unbound leaf.

anchor_format: doc anchors are <zip-relative entry>:<line>, resolvable offline against the named sha256_16. Code anchors are file:line|context, carried forward from H5 unchanged.
